title: Ten essentials
summary: Pack these on every trip into the backcountry, even a short one.

items.text: Navigation: map and compass, plus a phone with a GPS app or a GPS unit, and a spare battery
Sun protection: sunglasses, sunscreen and a hat
Fire: waterproof matches or a lighter, and fire starter
Emergency shelter: space blanket, bivy sack or tarp
Extra food: a day’s worth beyond your plan
Extra water, and a way to treat more
Extra layers: insulation and rain gear

sources.name: The Mountaineers, Ten Essentials: The Classic List and the Ten Essential Systems (citing Mountaineering: The Freedom of the Hills, 9th edition), Olympia Branch handout
sources.used: The ten systems; navigation with a GPS device or phone with a GPS app and extra batteries; headlamp plus extra batteries; sunglasses and sunscreen; knife; matches, lighter and tinder; extra water or the means to purify

sources.name: National Park Service, Ten Essentials
sources.used: Extra battery for your phone; sunglasses, sunscreen and hats; first-aid kit; matches (preferably waterproof) or lighter and fire starters; knife or multi-tool; an extra day's supply of food; tent, tarp, bivy sack or emergency space blanket; rain shell and jacket
